item.title: Sa’ar warns UK: If Britain acts against Israel, Israel will act
item.description: Foreign Minister Gideon Sa’ar warns Britain of retaliation if London imposes sanctions over Israeli construction plans in the E1 area.

item.title: Winter tells supporters: Don’t be swayed by the pressure, we are the right
item.description: At a rally for his new party, Ofer Winter tells activists, “Don’t be swayed by the pressure. We represent the true voice of the Israeli people and will sit with Netanyahu."

item.title: IDF: Interceptors fired towards suspicious aerial target, the results are under review
item.description:
The IDF Spokesperson's Unit said that following the sirens that sounded a short while ago regarding a hostile aircraft infiltration in several areas in northern Israel, interceptors were launched toward a suspicious aerial target that likely crossed from Lebanon into Israeli territory. The interception results are under review. No injuries were reported.
Missile and rocket alerts were activated due to the interception attempts.

item.title: IDF: UAV incident in Galilee panhandle has ended, under investigation
item.description:
The IDF said that the aircraft intrusion incident in the Galilee panhandle has ended and is currently being investigated.
At this time, there is no change in the assessment of the situation. No special instructions have been issued to the public, and schools and student transportation will operate as usual.

item.title: IAEA: Syrian site struck by Israel in 2007 consistent with a nuclear reactor
item.description: The IAEA says a Syrian site bombed by Israel in 2007 held infrastructure consistent with a nuclear reactor and that Assad-era authorities failed to declare nuclear activities.

item.title: Sirens sound in Bahrain, Interior Ministry warns of 'possible threat'
item.description:
Sirens sounded in Bahrain overnight, according to local reports.
Bahrain’s Interior Ministry issued a warning of a “possible threat" and called on citizens and residents to move to a safe location.

item.title: New European initiative could hurt Israel
item.description: A new EU initiative calls for changing foreign policy decision-making, replacing unanimity with qualified-majority voting.

item.title: CENTCOM announces completion of latest wave of strikes against Iran
item.description:
US Central Command (CENTCOM) announced that its forces successfully completed the latest wave of strikes against Iranian military targets.
“US forces struck Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) targets including air defense sites, radar systems, maritime assets and facilities, mine laying capabilities, and communications sites," it said.

item.title: Explosions heard in Kuwait following Iranian missile and drone attack
item.description:
Explosions were heard in Kuwait early Wednesday morning.
The Kuwaiti army later stated that the country's air defenses are engaging Iranian ballistic missiles and drones.

item.title: Reports in Iran of drone strikes on a US base in Bahrain
item.description:
Iranian media reported overnight that Tehran attacked a US military base in Bahrain using drones.
Reuters noted that there has been no official confirmation of the report at this time.

item.title: Jordanian military: 13 Iranian ballistic missiles launched at the kingdom
item.description:
The Jordanian military said Iran launched 13 ballistic missiles toward the kingdom. The country’s air defense systems intercepted 10 of them, while the remaining three missiles, according to the military, “exploded in areas far from population centers."
Meanwhile, two US officials told Reuters that there were no casualties among American forces stationed in Jordan.

item.description: The Tanya compacts four millennia of Jewish wisdom to answer the great personal and existential questions of life. It has revolutionized the way we think about G -d the human soul, the world and our place in it.

item.description: Iran launches ballistic missiles toward US bases in Jordan after American strikes on Iran.

item.title: During Iranian missile fire: El Al flight from Tel Aviv to Bangkok forced to circle over Jordan
item.description: At Jordan’s direction, during the Iranian missile fire on Tuesday evening, an El Al flight from Tel Aviv to Bangkok was forced to circle in the air.

item.title: Netanyahu: There was no betrayal on October 7, but there was a failure
item.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu addressed on Tuesday evening the controversy sparked by remarks made by his wife on Channel 14 regarding conspiracy theories that have circulated surrounding October 7.
“I have been asked several times whether I think there was a betrayal, and I answered that there was not. There was a major failure, which was reflected in what happened on the night and morning before the attack, when all the signs were there, and they decided, due to a miscalculation, not to wake me up and not to launch a preemptive attack. It was a failure, but not a betrayal, and my wife did not say anything like that either," Netanyahu said.

item.title: Haredi commander responds to Shas council member’s call and quits IDF
item.description: A haredi commander serving in a classified technological unit in the IDF resigned following a direct instruction he received from a Shas Council of Torah Sages member.

item.title: Sara Netanyahu fires back at Yair Golan
item.description: Sara Netanyahu’s attorney sent a warning letter to Yair Golan in response to his demand for an apology. The letter claims that it was Golan who defamed her over the years.

item.title: Rabbi Aviner responds to question on Ofer Winter's party
item.description: Rabbi Shlomo Aviner rejects the idea of voting for Ofer Winter’s party, over Yoseph Haddad’s No. 2 placement.

item.title: Dramatic arrest: Al Jazeera airs footage of Hamas security chief shot before capture
item.description: Al Jazeera publishes footage showing the moments when Hamas’s internal security commander was shot, seconds before his capture.

item.title: Netanyahu meets Congo President
item.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu met today (Tuesday) at his office with the President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo Félix Tshisekedi.
During their meeting, the Prime Minister and the President agreed to strengthen the economic and security relations between the two countries.
Prime Minister Netanyahu said to President Tshisekedi: "It is a pleasure welcoming our good friend, the President of the Republic of Congo, in Israel. It is a great friendship. We are strengthening it, and this visit will only help strengthen it even further. So welcome, Mr. President!"

item.title: Shin Bet raids terrorist's home | New details from the arrest of a senior Hamas official
item.description: In a joint IDF-Shin Bet operation, a terrorist working to reestablish the organization in northern Gaza was arrested and taken to Israel for questioning.
